explanation:
The theorem says that two library-defined maps, `backward` and `forward`, are inverse on the hom-sets between the inverse image of a presheaf of modules (built with `pointwiseLeftKanExtension`) and a module over the extended ring presheaf. It is the left-inverse half of a hom-set bijection for the explicit pullback/pushforward adjunction. Its content lies in those definitions.

I found nothing matching in Mathlib. `pointwiseLeftKanExtension` does not appear under `Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat`. `Presheaf/Pullback.lean` obtains the pullback abstractly, as a left adjoint through partial adjoints, with no explicit hom-set formulas. `Presheaf/Sheafification.lean` has `sheafificationHomEquiv`, which concerns sheafification and not this construction. `AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean` has `pullbackPushforwardAdjunction`, which is for sheaves and is also abstract. None of these states the theorem or yields it in one or two lines.
